description: Claude Code: deleting the last importer of payments through Bash leaves the dependency and the export unused, and Stop blocks

expect.message:
buckets: 2 structure violations remain. Fix the code or edit buckets.config.json. Either is valid.

billing -> payments: declared but never imported ("Charges go through the gateway")
  choose one fix:
  fix code: if billing still needs payments, import from a public file of payments
  fix config: remove "payments" from buckets.billing.dependsOn

payments: export charge is not imported by any bucket (src/payments/index.ts:1)
  choose one fix:
  fix code: remove charge from src/payments/index.ts, or import it where a bucket needs it
  fix config: if code outside this project uses it, add "external": "<one-line reason>" to buckets.payments
